title: Window Functions & Analytical Queries
description: Perform advanced analytics across row sets without collapsing rows using OVER, PARTITION BY, ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, and LAG/LEAD.

data.text: Unlike `GROUP BY`, which collapses multiple rows into a single row, a **Window Function** computes a calculation across a set of table rows related to the current row, while **retaining individual row identities** in the output.

data.title: Core Window Clauses
items: **`PARTITION BY`**: Divides rows into distinct groups (windows) that share the same partition key.
**`ORDER BY`**: Dictates the sorting of rows within each partition.
**Frame Specification (`ROWS / RANGE BETWEEN ...`)**: Defines the subset of rows within the partition evaluated for each row.

data.title: Month-Over-Month Revenue Growth with LAG()
data.content: Comparing current month revenue against previous month revenue.
data.code:
SELECT 
    sales_month,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY sales_month) AS prev_month_revenue,
    ROUND(
        (revenue - LAG(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY sales_month)) * 100.0 / 
        NULLIF(LAG(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY sales_month), 0), 2
    ) AS growth_percentage
FROM monthly_sales
ORDER BY sales_month DESC;

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Window functions calculate metrics across partitions while keeping every original row.
Use `LAG` and `LEAD` to inspect preceding or following rows without self-joins.
